inputs.checklistItemText: Non-utility-compatible trees proposed within 15 lateral feet of overhead electric distribution conductor or equipment
inputs.question: Based on the graphic scale shown on the landscape plan (1"=20'-0"), visually estimate the horizontal distance from the overhead electric line (-OHE-) along the southern boundary to the proposed trees marked with 'M' symbols. Are any of these trees located less than approximately 15 feet (measured on the scale) from the overhead electric line?
inputs.regionHint: southern boundary where the OHE line and M-labeled trees are shown together
